tools.name: check_requirements
tools.description: Check whether a given Node and Chrome version can run sponsio's live capture.

tools.name: explain_severity
tools.description: Explain how sponsio grades a change to a WebMCP tool contract, and why a changed description or a dropped readOnly annotation is graded the way it is.

limit.description: How many categories to return. Defaults to all of them.
